senses.gloss: f. (שָׁחַז) whetting implement of stone or wood.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 17:17">Kel. XVII, 17</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 7:10">Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. VII, 10</cite> <he>מ׳ שיש בה בית וכ׳</he> a (wooden) whetter which has a receptacle for oil.
<cite ref="Beitzah 28a:14">Bets. 28ᵃ</cite> <he>מ׳ של אבן</he> a whetstone; <he>מ׳ של עץ</he> a wooden whetter; a. fr. [Ar. reads <he>מַשְׁחֵז</he>.]
